validation.customerName: The company name is required (max 100 characters).

contact.title: Contact person
contact.nameRequired: Enter the surname or the first name.
contact.confirmDelete: Confirm deletion of the contact person?

convert.title: Convert the lead into a customer
convert.note: The lead becomes a customer (a new one with its data, or an existing one) with the contact person; activities and notes move to the customer.
convert.newCustomer: New customer from the lead data

send.title: Send the offer
send.note: The offer is sent as an attached PDF and becomes "Sent".

customerEdit.title: Customer card
customerEdit.newNote: Save the customer to add contacts, opportunities, activities, offers, notes and attachments.

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.dragNote: Drag a card to change its phase (or use the arrows button). Won and lost of the last 30 days.

opportunityEdit.title: Opportunity
opportunityEdit.confirmDelete: Confirm deletion of the opportunity (with history, activities and notes)?

activityEdit.title: Activity
activityEdit.leadNote: Lead activity: after conversion it moves to the customer.

offerEdit.title: Offer
offerEdit.confirmDelete: Confirm deletion of the draft offer?
offerEdit.pdfStarted: PDF being prepared: you will find it in the job bar when ready.
offerEdit.lifecycleNote: Once sent (also with the Send button) the offer is in the deadlines until its validity date; past the validity without an outcome it becomes Expired. Accepted: the linked opportunity, if open, moves to the won phase with the offer value.

parList.title: CRM tables
parList.note: A value in use cannot be deleted: deactivate it (it stays in the history but is no longer offered).

parEdit.phaseNote: The "won" and "lost" phases close the opportunity; at least one active phase of each type must remain.

settings.title: CRM settings
settings.visibilityNote: With "only their own" they see the customers they own, those without an owner and those they are involved in. Administrators always see everything.
settings.reminderNote: Pop-up notice to the assignee before the activity starts; 0 = no reminder.
settings.terms: Terms at the bottom of the PDF

reassign.title: Reassignment
reassign.note: Moves a sales rep's data to another user (or leaves it without an owner), e.g. when they leave.

requestList.title: Support requests
requestList.note: Requests from the company's customers (not tickets to the platform support). Open requests with high or urgent priority are highlighted.

requestEdit.title: Support request
requestEdit.confirmDelete: Delete the request and its messages?
requestEdit.newNote: After the first save you can add internal notes; the assignee receives a notification.
requestEdit.readOnly: The request is assigned to another user: you can read it and add notes, not change it.

features.sottotitolo: Everything you need to follow customers and deals, from the first contact to the offer.

clienti.title: Customers and contacts
clienti.text: Single company registry with sales status, owner, source, tags and contact persons.

dettaglio.intro: A single registry for customers and prospects, with everything salespeople need: details, people to contact and the history of the relationship.
punti: Customer card with contacts, opportunities, activities, offers, notes and attachments
Sales status: prospect, customer, former customer or not interested
Sales owner, source and tags for each customer
Industry, estimated turnover, number of employees and website
Contact people with role, phone, email and main contact

lead.title: Leads
lead.text: Not yet qualified contacts, converted into a customer with one click together with the opportunity.

dettaglio.intro: New contacts (website, trade fair, word of mouth) stay separate from customers until they are qualified.
punti: Lead with name, company, email, phone, source and notes
Activities recorded on the lead too, before conversion
Conversion into a new customer or an existing one
On conversion the person becomes a contact of the customer and an opportunity can be created at once
The lead's activities and notes move to the customer after conversion

pipeline.title: Opportunities and pipeline
pipeline.text: Value, probability and expected close; the history of every phase change.

dettaglio.intro: Ongoing deals, split by stage: salespeople move them forward, managers see at a glance what each stage is worth.
punti: Column view with cards you drag from one stage to another
List view as an alternative to columns
Value, probability and expected close date for each opportunity
Loss reason required when an opportunity is closed as lost
History of every stage change in the opportunity card
Stages set by the company, of type open, won and lost

agenda.title: Activity agenda
agenda.text: Today, overdue and upcoming: calls, emails, meetings, with the outcome recorded.

dettaglio.intro: Every salesperson's activities in one agenda: calls, emails and meetings linked to customers, leads and opportunities.
punti: Today's, overdue, upcoming and done or cancelled activities
Filter to show only the activities assigned to you
Outcome recorded when the activity is marked as done
Assigned activities shown in your personal calendar through an .ics feed
Activity types configurable in the CRM tables

promemoria.title: Reminders
promemoria.text: A pop-up notice before each activity, with the button to open it.

dettaglio.intro: No forgotten appointments: whoever is signed in to the application gets a notice shortly before each activity.
punti: Pop-up notice before each assigned activity starts
Notice time set by the company in the CRM settings (30 minutes by default)
Button in the notice to open the activity straight away
Sent only to the user the activity is assigned to

offerte.title: Offers
offerte.text: Numbering per year, price-list products, PDF with your terms and sending by email.

dettaglio.intro: Offers prepared in a few steps from the price list, with calculated totals and a PDF ready to send to the customer.
punti: Lines with products and services from the price list, quantity, price and discount
Taxable amount, VAT and total calculated automatically
Yearly numbering with prefix and default validity
PDF with the company's terms, sent by email as an attachment
A sent offer stays in the deadlines until its validity date, then expires without an outcome
Accepted offer: the linked opportunity moves to the won stage with its value

note.title: Notes and attachments
note.text: Pinned notes and files on customers, opportunities and offers.

dettaglio.intro: What you know about a customer or a deal stays written in its card, available to the whole sales team.
punti: Free notes on customers and opportunities, with author and date
Important notes pinned at the top
Attachments on customers, opportunities and offers, up to 20 MB per file
CRM attachments do not use document management storage

visibilita.title: Sales rep visibility
visibilita.text: Each sales rep sees their own customers, or everyone sees everything: the company decides.

dettaglio.intro: The company decides what each salesperson sees, with a single setting.
punti: Salespeople see only their own customers, or all customers
With own only: also customers without an owner and those they are involved in
Administrators always see everything
The same rule applies to opportunities, leads and activities

report.title: Reports
report.text: Pipeline by phase and owner, won and lost by reason, lead conversion, activities per user.

dettaglio.intro: Sales figures for a chosen period, to see how the pipeline and the salespeople's work are going.
punti: Opportunities won and lost in the period and win rate
Open pipeline by stage and by owner, including the weighted value
Won by owner and lost by reason
Leads created and converted in the period
Activities done by user

riassegna.title: Reassignment
riassegna.text: When a sales rep leaves, their customers and deals move to a colleague in one go.

dettaglio.intro: When a salesperson changes role or leaves the company, their work moves to a colleague without editing records one by one.
punti: Customers, opportunities, leads and pending activities reassigned in one go
Data moved to another user or left without an owner
If the user is removed their customers are not lost: they are left without an owner
Their pending activities are cancelled on removal

export.title: Excel export
export.text: The customer list with the chosen filters, ready in Excel.

dettaglio.intro: The customer list goes to Excel just as you see it on screen, ready for analysis or mailings.
punti: Excel export of the customer list
Uses the same filters set on the page
With status, owner, contact details, tags and open opportunities
No manual copying of data

gdpr.title: Privacy consent
gdpr.text: Consent to marketing communications with its date, on customers and leads.

dettaglio.intro: Consent to marketing communications is stored with the contact's details, together with the date it was given.
punti: Marketing consent with date on the customer card
Marketing consent with date on leads too
Visible at a glance before contacting someone
Access to data limited by the salespeople visibility rule

integrato.title: Integrated
integrato.text: The same customers as attendance and document management, without duplicate registries.

dettaglio.intro: The CRM works on the same customer registry as the other applications: no duplicate records.
punti: The same customers as attendance tracking and document management
Sales data is added to the shared customer card
A customer used by opportunities, offers, activities or attachments cannot be deleted by mistake
Enabled per company together with the other applications, with a single sign-in

pricing.sottotitolo: Choose the plan by the number of customers you manage: start for free, with every feature always included.
pricing.nota: Prices exclude VAT. No commitment: cancel whenever you want.

installare.domanda: Do I need to install anything?
installare.risposta: No: the CRM is used from the browser of your computer or smartphone.

visibilita.domanda: Does every sales rep see all customers?
visibilita.risposta: The company decides: only their own customers (default) or all of them; administrators always see everything.

presenze.domanda: Can I use it together with attendance management?
presenze.risposta: Yes: customers and contacts are the same in all active applications.

dati.risposta: Yes: the customer list exports to Excel and offers to PDF.

about.sottotitolo: We have worked for years alongside small and medium businesses and their sales teams.
about.paragrafo1: We know the work of those who sell: contacts scattered across emails and phones, offers to redo, deals that get lost.
about.paragrafo2: {{siteName}} puts this work in order: every customer has its card, every deal its phase and every offer its PDF.

semplice.title: Simple for sales reps
semplice.text: Logging a call or a meeting takes a few seconds.

ordinato.title: Orderly for managers
ordinato.text: Everyone's pipeline, results and activities always at hand.

vicino.title: Close to businesses
vicino.text: Designed with people who sell every day, not for large corporations.

register.sottotitolo: Create your company's account and start following customers and deals.
register.condizioni: I accept the terms of service and the privacy policy
register.inviata: We sent you an email with the link to activate the account: open it to complete the registration.
register.esito: Your company is ready. These are the users created: log in with the password you chose.

crm.title: CRM manual
crm.description: Customers, leads, pipeline and opportunities, agenda and reminders, PDF offers, notes and attachments, reports; for administrators visibility, tables, settings and reassignment.
